sources.text:
## Purpose

Project Borealis makes internal risk-reporting dependencies understandable. It helps analysts trace a reporting input back through upstream operational systems, identify the owner of that input, and locate supporting review records. This is operational lineage work, not a fund-performance forecasting system.

## Source responsibilities

The Data Platform team owns Harbor Access Register's operational source records. The Risk Analytics team owns the lineage inventory in Signal Lineage Board. A request to correct an upstream access-review record goes to its Data Platform owner; a request to correct a lineage link goes to Risk Analytics.

## Dependencies

Harbor provides its access-review records as an upstream input to Project Borealis. Harbor does not own Borealis's risk-reporting lineage inventory. DEC-002 documents approval of Harbor's access-review workflow; DEC-003 documents registration of Harbor Access Register as a Borealis source.

## Risk lineage mapping

Alex Rivera and Sofia Alvarez have the skill Risk Lineage Mapping. It covers tracing internal risk-reporting inputs through dependencies to their source systems. It does not include forecasting investment performance or guaranteeing returns.
